subject: Scan cadence & remediation validation — packet request

Subject: Request: scan cadence + remediation evidence for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi David,

We're preparing our SIG and SOC 2 evidence bundle for an upcoming audit and need a compact packet from Redwood that demonstrates your vulnerability management posture. Specifically we need: 
- a brief summary of scan cadence (network/authenticated/static) and who runs them,
- the SLA/target time-to-remediation per severity tier,
- an export of the last 6 months of scan findings (CSV preferred),
- a patch manifest showing deployed hotpatches and dates, and
- a sample rollback log or incident where a remediation was rolled back with timeline.

Can you provide a downloadable packet or Drive link and a short attestation we can include in the SIG? Our deadline to include this in the materials is close of business Thursday 2027-05-06. If you need more time, let us know.

Thanks,
Arcadia Security
security@arcadiabank.com

--
Arcadia Bank - InfoSec

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scan cadence + remediation evidence for SIG/SOC2 review

Uploading the export now and summarizing cadence/SLA for the attestation. Packet contents (uploaded to Drive): arcadia_scan_export_202705.zip, redwood_patch_manifest_202705.pdf, rollback_log_202703.csv. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Arcadia/2027-05-scan-pack

Quick cadence + SLA summary to include in the one-pager:
- Scan cadence:
  * Weekly unauthenticated network scans (internal schedule automated via InsightOps)
  * Monthly authenticated scans (credentialed scanners run during maintenance windows)
  * Quarterly full-scope infra + container scans (coordination with infra & platform teams)
- Remediation SLA (target time-to-remediate from vulnerability confirmation):
  * Critical (P0) - remediation or mitigation within 7 calendar days; emergency patching/rollback plan if not deployable immediately.
  * High (P1) - remediation or compensating control within 30 calendar days.
  * Medium (P2) - mitigated or scheduled within 90 calendar days.
  * Low (P3) - tracked to next maintenance cycle (up to 180 days).
- Exception process: documented in change request ticket (link included in manifest). Exceptions require owner, compensating control, and approval by Security (Director-level).
- Hotpatch / rollback notes: we maintain a rollback_log for any hotpatches; sample included (rollback_log_202703.csv) showing a March 2027 rollback initiated due to service regression, with rollback completed in 3 hours and ticket references.

I also included the patch manifest with CVE mappings and change ticket IDs. If Arcadia needs a signed attestation, David can sign the one-pager once Monica OKs the final language.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security Engineer, Vulnerability Operations
Redwood Inference

1) Please confirm the retention policy reference in writing (we need a short sentence confirming 3 years of scan artifact retention and where the policy is stored).
2) We require a signed attestation (PDF) from an authorized Redwood security representative that the cadence/SLA info is accurate as of 2027-05-07.
3) For exceptions: please include the recent change ticket IDs and the names/emails of approvers for the sample exception included in the manifest.

If you can provide those three items by Monday 2027-05-10 EOD, we will include this in our SIG packet and mark the request closed.
